'''Bel Nerodia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a notorious criminal during the [[Galactic War]]. He took over the minor [[Dust Vipers]] gang operating on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and quickly made it into a force to be reckoned with for the entire [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. The gang established a base near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] and possessed enough starfighters to conduct pirate raids on trade route vessels along the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: The Dust Vipers}}</ref> Following the death of Empress [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3631 BBY]], the Dust Vipers ambushed an Alliance supply convoy and obtained security plans for the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]]. This prompted the Alliance to [[Destruction of the Dust Vipers|retaliate]] against the Dust Vipers: a task force was send into their compound, where they defeated [[Jai Quallo]], [[Crack-Shot Aggy]] and even their prisoner [[Rakesh]] the Foul. Eventually Bel Nerodia himself confronted the group with the droid [[G9-RX]], but was defeated and killed, leaving the remaining Dust Vipers leaderless.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bel Nerodia appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as the final boss fight of "Done and Dusted" Uprising.
